NegozioDemo SRL — Shop Information

NegozioDemo has been a reference point in Turin for 10 years in smartphones, technical support, and guaranteed refurbished devices.

We offer a wide selection of new, used, and refurbished phones, all tested and guaranteed.

Trade-in: you can trade your old phone — even if damaged — to pay less for your next device. We also buy used devices with immediate payment if you do not wish to purchase.

Payment in 3 interest-free instalments is available via Klarna.

Repairs: our store technicians can diagnose and repair most consumer devices, often within a few hours.

Address: Via Demo 6a, 10125 Turin, Italy
Website: https://www.negoziodemo.example
Hours: Mon–Sat 09:30–13:00, 14:00–19:00. Closed Sunday.

Warranty and security:
- Sold by a registered shop (not a private seller)
- Invoice available on request
- After-sales support available

Payment methods:
- Bank transfer in advance
- Cash on delivery (+10 EUR)
- 3 instalments via Klarna (+5%)

Device condition policy:
- Guaranteed used devices
- Full hardware and software testing
- No iCloud lock
- Fully functional
- Battery health reported at 100% for this listing category
